items.label: Fed funds target
items.tip: The Fed's target range for overnight rates. It anchors short-term borrowing costs and is the main dial for liquidity.

items.label: 10Y real yield
items.tip: 10-year TIPS yield: the yield after inflation. Higher real yields are a headwind for non-yielding assets; falling ones tend to ease it.

items.label: Yield curve 2s10s
items.tip: 10-year minus 2-year Treasury yield. Below zero (inverted) has historically flagged recession risk; positive means a normal curve.

items.label: M2 money supply YoY
items.tip: Growth of the broad US money supply over 12 months (monthly, seasonally adjusted). Faster growth means more dollars chasing assets.

items.label: Fed balance sheet
items.tip: Total assets held by the Federal Reserve (weekly, Wednesday). Shrinking drains liquidity; growing adds it.

items.label: US CPI inflation YoY
items.tip: Year-over-year change in the all-items consumer price index (BLS, monthly). The headline inflation rate the Fed watches.

items.label: US spot BTC ETF flows
items.tip: Net daily creations minus redemptions across the US spot Bitcoin ETFs (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC and others), in US$ millions. Shown for the latest session.
